verdict.rationale: Semgrep's local/offline scanning model (code never uploaded by default) provides a strong privacy-friendly default that limits data retention concerns, as noted in docs and community reports. However, there is no evidence of explicit controls for deleting findings/data stored in the Semgrep AppSec Platform, data retention policies, or account/data-erasure mechanisms. Missing for 10: documented data retention policy, explicit deletion/export controls for cloud-stored findings, and any GDPR/CCPA-style data handling statement.
